feature: Fix 12 doc-trust and internal doc consistency issues identified in v2 technical debt audit
problem: 57 technical debt items were catalogued at the v2 tag. The highest-priority category (18 outdated docs) contains 12 items that break consumer trust: ghost script references, wrong scenario counts, missing tool entries, stale ACAM claims, wrong skill counts, and missing RULES_CHANGELOG entries. These make the docs actively misleading.
proposed_solution: Fix all 12 items across 6 files: docs/EVAL_GUIDE.md (3 fixes), AGENTS.md (2 fixes), README.md (2 fixes), library/cursor/rules/RULES_CHANGELOG.md (1 fix: add 8 missing rules), .harness/state.json vision (1 fix), and .harness/docs/research/phase-4-workflows.md (1 fix). Scope does not touch harness-internal housekeeping (chore-v2-debt-harness covers that).
acceptance_criteria: docs/EVAL_GUIDE.md contains no reference to capture_eval_baseline.py — grep -c 'capture_eval_baseline' docs/EVAL_GUIDE.md exits 0 (count=0); the three occurrences (L452, L459, L527) are replaced with eval_regression_check.py --update-baseline equivalents

docs/EVAL_GUIDE.md scenario counts updated: grep -c '28 scenario' docs/EVAL_GUIDE.md exits 0 (count=0); the two stale occurrences (L35: '28 scenarios', L173: '28 scenarios: 27 standard + 1 long') now say 31 and '31 scenarios: 30 standard + 1 long' respectively

docs/EVAL_GUIDE.md Tier 1 tools table includes acam-score.py: grep -qi 'acam-score' docs/EVAL_GUIDE.md exits 0 within the 'Tier 1' or 'Tools' section; the three-row table at L60-62 now has a fourth row for scripts/acam-score.py

docs/EVAL_GUIDE.md CI table nightly row corrected: grep -q 'all judge tiers' docs/EVAL_GUIDE.md exits 1 (not found); line previously at L425 now says 'structural tier' or 'structural judge' instead of 'all judge tiers'

AGENTS.md Configuration row no longer claims 'ablation running': grep -q 'ablation running' AGENTS.md exits 1 (not found); the Configuration evidence cell reflects actual state (e.g., 'per_rule_effectiveness check pending — ablation code exists, data artifact not yet committed')

README.md skill count updated: grep -q '13 skill workflows' README.md exits 1 (not found); updated to '14 skill workflows'; and llm-skeptic appears in the skills section: grep -qi 'llm-skeptic' README.md exits 0

library/cursor/rules/RULES_CHANGELOG.md has entries for all 8 previously missing rules: grep matches all of architecture.mdc, causal_rigor.mdc, design_principles.mdc, prompt_coaching.mdc, python_ml.mdc, research_standards.mdc, security.mdc, testing.mdc as level-2 headings (^## <name>.mdc) — verified with grep -c '^## architecture.mdc' etc. each returning 1

.harness/state.json vision field no longer contains '41 scenario': python3 -c "import json; s=json.load(open('.harness/state.json')); assert '41 scenario' not in s['vision'], 'stale 41 found'" exits 0; the count is updated to 31

.harness/docs/research/phase-4-workflows.md no longer contains stale zero-coverage skill-activation claims: test $(grep -ciE 'zero scenarios exercising|not one eval scenario|\\*\\*0 scenarios\\*\\*|Zero Skill Activation Eval Coverage|zero skill activation eval coverage' .harness/docs/research/phase-4-workflows.md) -eq 0; and doc reflects 3 existing scenarios: grep -qiE 'skill-activation|3 skill.activation' .harness/docs/research/phase-4-workflows.md exits 0 (L213, L223, L91 edge-case occurrences must be corrected, not deleted)
edge_cases: capture_eval_baseline.py appears in 3 distinct contexts in EVAL_GUIDE.md (Baseline refresh policy prose L452, code block L459, Measurement Cadence Runbook code block L527) — all three must be replaced; the correct replacement command is: python tests/eval/eval_regression_check.py --update-baseline --run-dir tests/eval_results/<latest> --tier pr

RULES_CHANGELOG.md entries for the 8 new rules need only minimal stubs (rule name as ## heading + ### v1.0 date + 1-line description of what the rule does) — they do not need full ablation data or hypothesis sections, which are optional per the existing pattern

phase-4-workflows.md L213 (**0 scenarios**), L223 (not one eval scenario), and L91 (zero scenarios exercising skill activation) must be corrected to reflect 3 skill-activation YAMLs in tests/eval/scenarios/ (skill-activation-code-quality-audit.yaml, skill-activation-code-review.yaml, skill-activation-llm-skeptic.yaml); do not delete research context, correct factual claims and section titles

AGENTS.md hooks table fix is OUT OF CONTRACT SCOPE for this task — state.json scope mentions '8 lean profile hooks' but AGENTS.md currently lists 6 (mixing full-profile hooks); defer to follow-up or chore-v2-debt-harness unless builder expands scope
README.md L28 tree diagram shows '13 skill workflows' — this is a directory tree, update the comment. A separate skills table or list in README may also need updating if present
verification_method:
Run from repo root:
# AC1
test $(grep -c 'capture_eval_baseline' docs/EVAL_GUIDE.md) -eq 0 && echo PASS-AC1 || echo FAIL-AC1
# AC2
test $(grep -c '28 scenario' docs/EVAL_GUIDE.md) -eq 0 && echo PASS-AC2 || echo FAIL-AC2
# AC3
grep -qi 'acam-score' docs/EVAL_GUIDE.md && echo PASS-AC3 || echo FAIL-AC3
# AC4
test $(grep -c 'all judge tiers' docs/EVAL_GUIDE.md) -eq 0 && echo PASS-AC4 || echo FAIL-AC4
# AC5
test $(grep -c 'ablation running' AGENTS.md) -eq 0 && echo PASS-AC5 || echo FAIL-AC5
# AC6
test $(grep -c '13 skill workflows' README.md) -eq 0 && grep -qi 'llm-skeptic' README.md && echo PASS-AC6 || echo FAIL-AC6
# AC7
for r in architecture.mdc causal_rigor.mdc design_principles.mdc prompt_coaching.mdc python_ml.mdc research_standards.mdc security.mdc testing.mdc; do grep -q "^## $r" library/cursor/rules/RULES_CHANGELOG.md || { echo FAIL-AC7-$r; exit 1; }; done && echo PASS-AC7
# AC8
python3 -c "import json; s=json.load(open('.harness/state.json')); assert '41 scenario' not in s['vision']; print('PASS-AC8')"
# AC9
test $(grep -ciE 'zero scenarios exercising|not one eval scenario|\*\*0 scenarios\*\*|Zero Skill Activation Eval Coverage|zero skill activation eval coverage' .harness/docs/research/phase-4-workflows.md) -eq 0 && grep -qiE 'skill-activation|3 skill.activation' .harness/docs/research/phase-4-workflows.md && echo PASS-AC9 || echo FAIL-AC9
